step: G P3-R5 (LAW.md L4.5): the ./aurora-config leaf entry, mirroring ./blob-config
why: P3-R5 accepts ./aurora-config as one new export key. The demo's eager shell and hero read the aurora configuration and its first-paint ground; through ./aurora that drags Aurora.vue and both renderers into the boot graph (B-research §8: 685,510 B doors-only against the 503,808 B ceiling). The leaf carries the three names the eager path reads, at the unit root beside the ./aurora door exactly as blob/config.ts sits beside blob/index.ts, so L2.5 keeps it at U (an entry source heads U). R-6 then gives the three names to the lighter door (L4.7), and ./aurora drops them in the one-door row.
